blocks.body:
# ATS autonomy and profitability-readiness technical audit

**Audit date:** 2026-08-31 IST  
**Execution scope:** A2 paper only; live money disabled; no real broker-order calls

## Technical summary

The system is materially safer after targeted correctness repairs, but it is **not ready for unattended market execution** and has no demonstrated profit guarantee. The frozen checkpoint did not enforce Stage 2 inside execution, accepted a 10-second live freshness window, and could silently stop scanning when real option evidence arrived. Those defects are fixed without changing C0, the 0.55 threshold, Portfolio Brain, Risk, A04, costs, sizing policy, or challenger authority.

The only defensible forward-alpha verdict is **SESSION_NOT_VALID_FOR_FORWARD_ALPHA** because no genuine NSE forward session has completed.

## Profitability is not established

C0 is a simple three-bar rate-of-change rule and has no valid forward option-economic sample. Historical calibration uses underlying outcomes, while the option selector estimates payoff through a delta-based proxy. Challenger forecast metrics are model-specific, but challenger order, fill, and P&L metrics are produced by an ordinary production controller rather than a controller using each challenger. These results cannot justify model promotion or expected-profit claims.

## Scope, methodology, and evidence

The audit traced lifecycle, Upstox V3 ingestion, freshness, option evidence, autonomous scanning, deterministic authorities, paper execution, evidence finalization, forensic reads, calibration provenance, research tournaments, test collection, typing, lint, frontend contracts, production build, and dependency audit. It placed no orders, called no real-order endpoint, changed no trading threshold, and promoted no model.

A system is considered autonomous-ready only when the exact reviewed HEAD passes fresh Stage 1 and live Stage 2, all decision-critical subscriptions are fresh, no operator-created candidate is needed, stale evidence fails closed, canonical finalization succeeds, and the evidence chain verifies. Profitability additionally requires forward net outcomes after real costs and adequate sample size.

## Next actions

1. Review and commit only the demonstrated correctness changes, then bind qualification to the new HEAD.
2. Run the pinned toolchain, PostgreSQL integration tests, and long research tests in separate bounded CI jobs.
3. Run fresh Stage 1 and Stage 2 on the target market date; do not override any blocker.
4. Collect Forward Session 01 with no manual entries and verify Stage 2, scanner-failure, data-quality, and integrity evidence.
5. Collect genuine option outcome labels and bind calibration data by version and hash before assessing profitability.
6. Repair challenger attribution and remove synthetic option assumptions before any promotion study.
7. Disable or authenticate local mutation routes in forward-experiment mode.

**Recommended action:** REQUALIFY_CORRECTED_HEAD_THEN_COLLECT_FORWARD_SESSION_01.

## Limitations and open questions

This premarket audit did not validate today's provider authentication, BOD truth, dynamic Monday contracts, live entitlement, market-open latency, disconnect recovery, real option depth and Greeks, autonomous candidates, paper fills, or end-of-day finalization under genuine NSE flow. Repository-wide Ruff still reports 303 findings. The broad Python suite reached 99% without failure after the fixes but was bounded during a long research tail; database-dependent tests require an external PostgreSQL service.

Open questions include whether C0 produces meaningful dispersion in real flow, how often legitimate option economics are available, whether fills and exits remain realistic after all costs, and whether five valid forward sessions show stable calibration and drawdown behavior.

readiness.conclusion: Paper-only invariants remain; no real-order endpoint was called.
Execution now requires LIVE state and all 22 dynamic keys fresh.
Production live silence and stale limits are 2,000 ms.
Canonical quote and Greek fields are used; scanner failures are visible.
Canonical manifests and legacy sessions are readable and verifiable.
No valid genuine NSE session or profit sample exists.

changes.resolution: Added an internal fail-closed execution invariant.
Aligned runtime and V3 supervisor to two seconds.

changes.defect: Real option quote fields caused hidden scanner failure
changes.resolution: Corrected fields and exported scanner-failure telemetry.

changes.defect: Forensics searched the wrong manifest and had broken reader code
changes.resolution: Canonical discovery, persisted identity, and legacy fallback added.
Scoped migrations to database consumers; fixed explicit replay lot fixtures.
